rows.text: You stroll through the stark and bare ruins, where particle obliterator worms devoured everything on this land during the Interstellar Energy War. Not even soil or rocks remain on its lifeless pallid surface. All that remains is a lonely vending machine.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: The vending machine carries out its duties with great pride. That is until your arrival destroys its luxury of never having to work.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "Logic: This machine is still in wartime management mode. Please prove that you have a higher investment value and greater chance of victory than your adversaries."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "This machine will evaluate the standards of your service based on your investment value."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "Or else, this machine will have justifiable cause to decide that supporting you will not stand to maximize the benefit for IPC and reject your request. Beep. Beep. Commencing your combat capability test."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Show it how strong you are.
Only victors are worth investing in.
"Beep. Beep. Test has begun. Please leave the scanning area."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: You better reconsider.
Demonstrate your domineering combat power.
The vending machine spits out the product.
The vending machine falls silent. For the first time in your life, you realize that machines have a habit of bullying the weak and fearing the strong, too.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Is this enough?
Demonstrate your average combat power.
The vending machine displays a discount.
This just goes to show that fists are the universal currency.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: It's too expensive.
You choose to leave.
One day, you'll make it beg you to buy its goods.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Do me a favor.
Demonstrate your feeble combat power.
The vending machine displays the price.
"Expensive things are expensive for a good reason," you tell yourself, trying to find comfort.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: I want freebies!
"Due to the ownership clauses, any threatening behavior towards this machine will be seen as a declaration of war against the IPC — battle mode activated."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Can't beat it. Time to run!
